localized_stationary_drain.executable_check: Reject global accumulator shifts; require stationary row/column indexed drain.

strict_extracted_electrical.executable_check: Require CAP_MARGIN >= 21 before launch and parse final extracted setup/hold/slew/fanout/cap counts.

external_sram_boundary.executable_check: Require external SRAM interface ports and reject behavioral SRAM-like arrays.

hierarchical_width_proof.executable_check: Require signed 12-bit chunk, signed 24-bit wide state, fold at 16, fold-boundary tests, and K=65535.

exactly_once_registered_response.executable_check: Require one chunk update site, paired requests, and separate accumulation/fold states.

control_plane_regression.executable_check: Require k_dim latching plus busy-start, reset-abort, clean-restart, signed-extrema, and tail tests.

disk_preflight.executable_check: Require launch-time df preflight with a fixed minimum free-space threshold.

marker_exit_integrity.executable_check: Require PIPESTATUS capture and parseable FLOW_RC marker.
